templates.name: form
templates.label: Form
templates.description: Collect and validate user input against a field schema, emitting the captured values on submit.
preconditions: A field schema (labels, types, required) is provided on `schema`
postconditions: `values` holds the captured fields once submitted
`submitted` flips true only after client-side validation passes

steps.label: Render fields
steps.detail: Build inputs from the schema (text / number / select / checkbox).

steps.label: Validate
steps.detail: Block submit until required fields are present and types are valid.

steps.label: Emit
steps.detail: On submit, return the collected values and submitted=true.

schema.description: Field schema: [{ name, label, type, required }]

templates.name: table
templates.label: Table / list
templates.description: Render rows in a sortable, selectable table from a column definition.
preconditions: A column definition is provided on `columns`
postconditions: `selected` reflects the row(s) the user picks

steps.label: Define columns
steps.detail: Map each column to a row field + header + optional formatter.

steps.label: Render rows
steps.detail: Render the rows; support sort by column and row selection.

steps.label: Emit selection
steps.detail: Return the selected row(s) when the user clicks.

templates.name: chart
templates.label: Chart
templates.description: Visualize one or more series as a line, bar, or pie chart.
postconditions: The chart renders for the chosen `type`

steps.label: Pick a chart type
steps.detail: line for trends, bar for comparisons, pie for composition.

steps.label: Map data
steps.detail: Map series points to axes / slices.

steps.label: Render
steps.detail: Draw the chart with axis labels + a legend.

templates.name: kpi-card
templates.label: KPI card
templates.description: Show a single headline metric with an optional delta against a prior period.
preconditions: A label and numeric value are provided

steps.label: Show the value
steps.detail: Render the headline number with the label.

steps.label: Show the delta
steps.detail: If a delta is given, show up/down with sign + colour.

templates.name: detail-view
templates.label: Detail view
templates.description: Render a single record as a read-only label/value detail panel.
postconditions: The selected fields render as label/value rows

steps.label: Pick fields
steps.detail: Use `fields` to choose + order which keys to show (default: all).

steps.label: Render
steps.detail: Render each as a label/value row; format dates + numbers.

templates.name: filter-bar
templates.label: Filter bar
templates.description: Render a set of filter controls and emit the resulting query as the user changes them.
preconditions: A filter-field definition is provided on `fields`

steps.label: Render controls
steps.detail: Build a control per field (text / select / date range).

steps.label: Collect
steps.detail: On change, assemble the active filters into a query object.

steps.label: Emit
steps.detail: Return the query so a downstream data block can re-fetch.
